jab aave karva chauth | Jab Aave Karwa Chauth | Karwa Chauth Special Song | Karva Chauth 2026 Special
karva chauth ke pavan tyohar par sunie sundar bhakti aur prem se bhara git “jab aave karva chauth”.
Karva chauth ka parv pati-patni ke prem, vishvas aur samarpan ka pratik hai. is vishesh avsar par suhagin mahilaen apne pati ki lanbi aayu, sukhi danpaty jivan aur parivar ki khushhali ki kamna karte hue vrat rakhti hain.
Karva chauth ki paranprik rasmon, chandramake darshanaaur tyauhar ki umang ke sath is madhur git ka aanand len aur apne priyajnon ke sath karva chauth ki khushiyan banten.
